candidates.name: Architectural Hardware Supply, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Own site lists 'Restroom Partitions & Accessories'. A federal contractor listing names toilet partitions and toilet accessories along with 'supply, installation, and service'. The SBDC profile says its products are 'furnished, installed and serviced' on Alaska government and institutional projects, such as Anchorage School District work.
candidates.reason: An Anchorage Division 8/10 specialty contractor that furnishes and installs specialty products and lists restroom partitions. No project or photo shows toilet partition installation specifically.
red_flags: Partition installation not shown in projects or photos

license.name: Architectural Hardware Supply, Inc.
license.registry: Municipality of Anchorage, Verify Municipal Contractor License (bsd.muni.org). The State of Alaska Construction Contractor license search (commerce.alaska.gov) returned HTTP 403 to automated access and was not checked.
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Searching the Anchorage municipal registry for 'Architectural Hardware' returned 'Architectural Hardware Supply Inc', (907) 522-0234, license CON7682, General Contractor (Generl), expires 02/14/2028. The registry lists only current municipal licenses. The phone number matches the company site (ahs-alaska.biz), which lists Restroom Partitions & Accessories among its products but does not say it installs partitions. The state license could not be checked online because the State of Alaska search (https://www.commerce.alaska.gov/cbp/main/search/professional) returns 403. A search result summary said Anchorage issues its license only after the state license is confirmed, but I did not read that on the official page, so state status is unverified. A state notary directory entry under the company name (aws.state.ak.us) is a notary commission, not a contractor license.
